question: Milo had 131 game tokens. He used 71 tokens on Saturday. He split the remaining tokens equally with his friend, keeping one of the 2 equal shares. Each token he kept is worth 9 minutes of play time. The arcade also gave Milo a bonus of 64 minutes, which is a little over an hour. How many minutes of play time does Milo have?

Owen saves 109 cents in coins every week, and his dad adds the same amount again, so that his saving is doubled. Owen also gets 29 cents each week from returning bottles. He keeps this up for 9 weeks. He then spends 961 cents, a little under ten dollars, on a book. His aunt gives him 35 cents in change. Finally his grandmother doubles whatever he has left. How many cents does Owen have now?

Tara raised 136 tomato seedlings in her greenhouse, and she waters them twice a day. She sold 94 seedlings to a garden centre, and 5 more wilted. Her neighbour Raj kept fewer seedlings than Tara did. Each of Tara's remaining plants produced 8 tomatoes, and she sold every tomato for 5 cents. She then spent 1089 cents on new seed packets. How many cents did Tara have left?

A publisher is printing a set of books. Each volume has 80 pages of story and 34 pages of notes, and there are 4 volumes in a set. A dozen index pages are added to every set. The publisher prints 2 copies of each set for every order, and receives 3 orders. The printing is split equally between 2 print shops. How many pages does the Northside print shop print?

In the morning Sofia had 111 muffins on her stall and baked 69 more. 17 of them were burnt and thrown out, and she sold every remaining muffin for 9 cents each. Her rival Tomas sold fewer muffins than Sofia that morning. In the afternoon she spent 1074 cents on flour and butter. In the evening she worked out that every one of the 8 days that week had gone exactly the same way. How many cents did Sofia keep over those 8 days?

Ivy had a dozen minutes of phone credit left, so she bought a top-up of 79 minutes. She then made a call lasting 57 minutes, nearly an hour. A promotion doubled the credit she had left. Her brother Max, who had 34 minutes of credit and less than Ivy, asked for help, so Ivy transferred 34 minutes to him. She then made a 33-minute call. How many minutes of credit does Ivy have left?

Wade gets 69 dollars a week from his part-time job. Each week he pays 49 dollars towards rent and earns 70 dollars tutoring, and he saves everything that is left. He does this for 6 weeks. He then gives half of his savings to his sister. He spends 51 dollars on a coat and receives a 76-dollar gift from his uncle. How many dollars does Wade have now?

In the morning a farmer filled 5 sacks with 45 kilograms of grain each, and then added 75 kilograms from a bin. In the afternoon he sold 221 kilograms at the market. In the evening he sold all the grain he had left for 3 dollars per kilogram, and then paid 186 dollars for fuel. How many dollars did he have left from the evening sale?

In the morning a warehouse held 112 crates, and 41 crates were shipped out. Each crate that stayed holds 9 boxes, and each box holds 2 bags. The warehouse has 4 loading doors. In the afternoon 41 loose bags were found on a shelf and added to the stock. In the evening the manager weighed the bags at 8 kilograms each, and 10502 kilograms of bags were loaded onto a train. How many kilograms of bags were left in the warehouse?

In the morning a theatre had 188 tickets printed for tonight's show, but 2 of them were torn and thrown away. In the afternoon 42 more tickets were printed, and every ticket was sold for 5 dollars. The show lasts 90 minutes. In the evening a visitor added a 26-dollar donation. How many dollars did the theatre take in?

A stamping machine makes 207 parts every minute. Each cycle runs for 6 minutes, and the machine completes 5 cycles, so a whole session takes half an hour. Half of the parts made are sent to the paint shop, and the rest go into a shipment. A worker then adds 9 spare parts from one bin and 9 spare parts from another bin to the shipment. How many parts are in the shipment?

Fin had 176 dollars in savings and earned 35 dollars more mowing lawns. His grandmother then doubled his savings. He spent 401 dollars on a bike and 11 dollars on a lock. He then earned 79 dollars washing cars. At the end of the month his bank gives him 9 reward points for every dollar in his account. How many reward points does Fin get?

Four friends drove to the coast. The driving took 145 minutes, then a traffic jam added 59 minutes, a lunch stop added 42 minutes, and refuelling added 22 minutes, so the whole trip lasted a little under four and a half hours. The car has 5 seats. The 4 friends took turns at the wheel and each was responsible for an equal share of the trip time. For how many minutes was Priya responsible?

In the morning a printing press ran for 7 minutes at 106 pages per minute, and then did a second run of exactly the same length, making 2 runs in all. In the afternoon 35 extra pages were printed and added, making up one full job. In the evening the manager confirmed that 5 identical jobs are printed every day, and that the press will run for 9 days. She also adds 27 sample pages to the final total. How many pages will be printed in total?

Gus has collected stickers for a dozen years. He had 138 stickers and gave 110 of them to a younger cousin. At a swap meet he traded each remaining sticker for a pack of 4 stickers, and then found 5 loose stickers in his bag. His album has 20 pages. He gave 53 stickers to his friend Hal, who now has fewer stickers than Gus. In the club contest every sticker is worth 9 points, and Gus also earned an 18-point bonus. How many points does Gus score?

A football team had 101 minutes booked for each training session, but the coach cancelled 66 minutes of drills, leaving each session at a little over half an hour. The team trains 9 sessions a week, and adds 27 minutes of stretching each week. The club runs 2 teams on exactly the same programme, and the season lasts 9 weeks. How many minutes of training does the club run in the season?

A village hall fund receives 219 dollars every month from the parish council. After 5 months the committee spent 917 dollars on a new roof. A raffle then added 57 dollars to the fund, and a bake sale added 62 dollars. How many dollars are in the fund now?

In the morning a baker measured 199 grams of flour for each loaf and added 16 grams for dusting, and she divided each loaf's dough equally into 5 rolls. The shop opens at half past six. In the afternoon she packed 7 rolls into each bag and 9 bags into each box. In the evening she shipped 7 boxes to a hotel. How many grams of flour went into the rolls she shipped?

Ali puts 76 dollars into his savings every week and adds a 43-dollar bonus he gets each week. Each week he takes 16 dollars back out for his phone and 8 dollars for snacks. He keeps this up for 4 weeks. His grandmother then gives him 30 dollars for his savings. How many dollars are in Ali's savings?

Jade earns 230 cents an hour at a cafe. She works 2 hours a day for 5 days, which comes to twenty-three dollars. Her brother Leo earns less per hour than Jade. A customer gave her a 75-cent tip, and she then spent 1933 cents on a train ticket. How many cents does Jade have left?

In the morning Omar filled his water tank from 5 barrels holding 46 litres each. He used 76 litres to water the orchard. In the afternoon he used 53 litres for the goats and sent 83 litres to his neighbour Nadia, whose tank holds less water than Omar's. In the evening rain added 55 litres to the tank. How many litres were in Omar's tank at the end of the evening?

Bea planted 183 pepper seeds in her garden, and she checks on them twice a day. 113 seeds never sprouted, and 21 seedlings were eaten by slugs. She bought 80 more seedlings from a nursery. Each plant in her garden produced 4 peppers. How many peppers did Bea harvest?

Leo had 27 dollars. He spent 23 dollars on a game and 2 dollars on a snack, and waited half an hour in the queue. At the arcade, each dollar he had left bought him 6 tokens. He won 59 tokens on a machine, and a friend gave him 21 tokens. The arcade session lasted an hour, which is sixty minutes. How many tokens does Leo have?

In the morning Ali had 54 flyers for the concert. His friend Bo, who had printed more flyers than Ali, gave him 56 flyers. Ali handed out 99 flyers on the high street. In the afternoon 4 flyers blew away in the wind. In the evening the print shop delivered 49 more to Ali. How many flyers does Ali have now?

In the morning a delivery van set out with 126 parcels and delivered 48 by half past ten. In the afternoon the driver delivered 52 parcels, then 24 more. In the evening she opened the parcels that were left: each contained 5 boxes, and each box weighed 3 kilograms. How many kilograms did the boxes in the leftover parcels weigh?
